segment_contamination_dimensions: Service-only buyers seeking installation, erection, or project management contracts for PEB/steel buildings — as opposed to buyers procuring physical steel building structures, kits, or turnkey supply+erect packages. The sibling MCAT 'Pre Engineered Metal Buildings Services' carves out the pure-service buyer segment; enhanced names and alt names for this MCAT must not attract buyers whose primary intent is to hire a service contractor rather than purchase a physical steel building product or supply-and-erect system.
